question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A piece of living tissue or plant that is transplanted surgically
solution:
The correct answer is: **Graft**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Graft: **A shoot or bud of one plant that is inserted into or joined to the stem, branch, or root of another plant so that the two grow together as a single plant. (जीवित ऊतक का एक टुकड़ा जिसे शल्य चिकित्सा द्वारा प्रत्यारोपित किया जाता है)
 
• So, it is clear that '**Graft**' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**A piece of living tissue or plant that is transplanted surgically​'**

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Gratis**: When something is offered gratis, it is free of charge. (जब कोई चीज मुफ्त में दी जाती है)
 
• **Gourmet**: A person who knows a lot about food and cooking, and who enjoys eating good food. (एक व्यक्ति जो भोजन और खाना पकाने के बारे में बहुत कुछ जानता है और जो अच्छा खाना खाने का आनंद लेता है)
 
• **Gracious**: Courteous, kind, and pleasant, especially towards someone of lower social status. (विनम्र, दयालु और सुखद, विशेष रूप से निम्न सामाजिक स्थिति के किसी व्यक्ति के प्रति)
